name: Pookie has a Fantasy 2
source:
You and your girlfriend Pookie have finally moved in together after overcoming a rocky past. As she chases her dream of becoming a game developer, it’s up to you to keep the lights on, food on the table, and love in the air. Balance work, affection, and choices that shape your future. Will your support be enough to keep her inspired—and by your side?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3812030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
经历过往的坎坷，你和女朋友普琪终于搬到了一起。她一心追逐成为游戏开发者的梦想，家里的电费、桌上的饭菜，以及两人之间的情意，都得靠你维持。平衡工作与感情，做出决定未来的选择。你的支持能让她一直有创作的动力，也让她一直留在你身边吗？

［取自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3812030/]Steam[/url]］
